interview_answer: I built a bias audit that runs automatically on every screening batch. It uses the EEOC 4/5ths rule (Disparate Impact Ratio) to check if the shortlist unfairly skews by university tier, employment gap, city, or experience level. Anything below DIR=0.80 is flagged for manual review. The model is a decision-support tool, not the final decision maker.
